links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses versus sixth-grade threshold across six readability indices
links.effect: All six readability indices differed across chatbots (all adjusted P<0.001); no response met the prespecified sixth-grade threshold on any of the six readability measures.
links.quote: All six readability indices differed across chatbots after Holm correction (all adjusted P<0.001), and no response met the prespecified sixth-grade threshold on any of the six readability measures.
